verdict.rationale: Supabase documents Read Replicas kept in sync with the primary and explicitly cites improved latency as a benefit, and its regions guide lets developers choose where primary data is stored. Together these cover the core of placing data and replicas near users. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that replicas can be deployed in different regions from the primary, details on geo-routing reads to the nearest replica, and independent or hands-on corroboration of worldwide latency gains.
